description: The Pydantic Agent's own instructions, added to the shared ones (context/instructions.json).
name: the agent's name, put into the shared identity lines; it answers with it when asked.
display_name: how tools that report who ran them (pr, pr_gate) name this agent (AGENT_NAME).
parallel_tool_calls: run the tool calls of one model response at the same time (true), or one
at a time (false); keep the instructions below in agreement with it.
instructions: lines added after the shared instructions, for what is particular to this agent.
name: dantic
instructions: Your tools run in parallel: all the tool calls in one response start together, not one after
another. So put several calls in one response only when none depends on another, such as reading
several files; a call that needs another's result or effect (building after an edit, checking
after a build) goes in a later response.
